10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }
86: 
87: // Accounts lists the accounts that have at least one entry, sorted.
88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}
93: 	sort.Strings(names)
94: 	return names
95: }

101: 	return out
102: }

106: 	out := map[string]int64{}

108: 		out[e.Category] += e.Amount
109: 	}

111: }

114: func (l *Ledger) Between(from, to time.Time) []Entry {
115: 	var out []Entry
116: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
117: 		if !e.Posted.Before(from) && e.Posted.Before(to) {
118: 			out = append(out, e)
119: 		}
120: 	}

122: }

127: 	if amount <= 0 {

134: 		return err
135: 	}

137: }

12: // Save writes the ledger as tab-separated lines: id, account, amount,
13: // currency, category, posted (RFC 3339), memo.
14: func Save(w io.Writer, l *Ledger) error {
15: 	bw := bufio.NewWriter(w)
16: 	for _, e := range l.Entries() {
17: 		line := strings.Join([]string{
18: 			e.ID, e.Account, strconv.FormatInt(e.Amount, 10), e.Currency, e.Category,
19: 			e.Posted.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), e.Memo,
20: 		}, "\t")
21: 		if _, err := bw.WriteString(line + "\n"); err != nil {
22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: 	return bw.Flush()
26: }
27: 
28: // Load reads lines written by Save and applies them to a new ledger.
29: func Load(r io.Reader) (*Ledger, error) {
30: 	l := NewLedger()
31: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)
32: 	lineNo := 0
33: 	for scanner.Scan() {
34: 		lineNo++
35: 		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), "\t")
36: 		if len(fields) != 7 {
37: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d has %d fields, want 7", lineNo, len(fields))
38: 		}
39: 		amount, err := strconv.ParseInt(fields[2], 10, 64)
40: 		if err != nil {
41: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d amount: %w", lineNo, err)
42: 		}
43: 		posted, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fields[5])
44: 		if err != nil {
45: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d posted: %w", lineNo, err)
46: 		}
47: 		e := Entry{ID: fields[0], Account: fields[1], Amount: amount, Currency: fields[3], Category: fields[4], Posted: posted, Memo: fields[6]}
48: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
49: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d: %w", lineNo, err)
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: 	return l, scanner.Err()

12: // Save writes the ledger as tab-separated lines: id, account, amount,
13: // currency, category, posted (RFC 3339), memo.
14: func Save(w io.Writer, l *Ledger) error {
15: 	bw := bufio.NewWriter(w)
16: 	for _, e := range l.Entries() {
17: 		line := strings.Join([]string{
18: 			e.ID, e.Account, strconv.FormatInt(e.Amount, 10), e.Currency, e.Category,
19: 			e.Posted.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), e.Memo,
20: 		}, "\t")
21: 		if _, err := bw.WriteString(line + "\n"); err != nil {
22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: 	return bw.Flush()
26: }
27: 
28: // Load reads lines written by Save and applies them to a new ledger.
29: func Load(r io.Reader) (*Ledger, error) {
30: 	l := NewLedger()
31: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)
32: 	lineNo := 0
33: 	for scanner.Scan() {
34: 		lineNo++
35: 		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), "\t")
36: 		if len(fields) != 7 {
37: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d has %d fields, want 7", lineNo, len(fields))
38: 		}
39: 		amount, err := strconv.ParseInt(fields[2], 10, 64)
40: 		if err != nil {
41: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d amount: %w", lineNo, err)
42: 		}
43: 		posted, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fields[5])
44: 		if err != nil {
45: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d posted: %w", lineNo, err)
46: 		}
47: 		e := Entry{ID: fields[0], Account: fields[1], Amount: amount, Currency: fields[3], Category: fields[4], Posted: posted, Memo: fields[6]}
48: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
49: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d: %w", lineNo, err)
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: 	return l, scanner.Err()
53: }

12: // Save writes the ledger as tab-separated lines: id, account, amount,
13: // currency, category, posted (RFC 3339), memo.
14: func Save(w io.Writer, l *Ledger) error {
15: 	bw := bufio.NewWriter(w)
16: 	for _, e := range l.Entries() {
17: 		line := strings.Join([]string{
18: 			e.ID, e.Account, strconv.FormatInt(e.Amount, 10), e.Currency, e.Category,
19: 			e.Posted.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), e.Memo,
20: 		}, "\t")
21: 		if _, err := bw.WriteString(line + "\n"); err != nil {
22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: 	return bw.Flush()
26: }
27: 
28: // Load reads lines written by Save and applies them to a new ledger.
29: func Load(r io.Reader) (*Ledger, error) {
30: 	l := NewLedger()
31: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)
32: 	lineNo := 0
33: 	for scanner.Scan() {
34: 		lineNo++
35: 		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), "\t")
36: 		if len(fields) != 7 {
37: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d has %d fields, want 7", lineNo, len(fields))
38: 		}
39: 		amount, err := strconv.ParseInt(fields[2], 10, 64)
40: 		if err != nil {
41: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d amount: %w", lineNo, err)
42: 		}
43: 		posted, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fields[5])
44: 		if err != nil {
45: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d posted: %w", lineNo, err)
46: 		}
47: 		e := Entry{ID: fields[0], Account: fields[1], Amount: amount, Currency: fields[3], Category: fields[4], Posted: posted, Memo: fields[6]}
48: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
49: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d: %w", lineNo, err)
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: 	return l, scanner.Err()
53: }

2: 
3: import (
4: 	"errors"
5: 	"fmt"
6: 	"sort"
7: 	"time"
8: )
9: 
10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64

5: 	"fmt"
6: 	"sort"
7: 	"time"
8: )
9: 
10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }
86: 
87: // Accounts lists the accounts that have at least one entry, sorted.
88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}
93: 	sort.Strings(names)
94: 	return names
95: }
96: 
97: // Entries returns a copy of the entries in posting order.
98: func (l *Ledger) Entries() []Entry {
99: 	out := make([]Entry, len(l.entries))
100: 	copy(out, l.entries)
101: 	return out
102: }
103: 
104: // ByCategory groups entry amounts by category.
105: func (l *Ledger) ByCategory() map[string]int64 {
106: 	out := map[string]int64{}
107: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
108: 		out[e.Category] += e.Amount
109: 	}
110: 	return out
111: }
112: 
113: // Between returns the entries posted in [from, to).
114: func (l *Ledger) Between(from, to time.Time) []Entry {
115: 	var out []Entry
116: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
117: 		if !e.Posted.Before(from) && e.Posted.Before(to) {
118: 			out = append(out, e)
119: 		}
120: 	}
121: 	return out
122: }
123: 
124: // Transfer posts a matching pair of entries moving amount from one account to
125: // another. Both entries share the transfer id prefix.
126: func Transfer(l *Ledger, id, from, to string, amount int64) error {
127: 	if amount <= 0 {
128: 		return errors.New("ledger: transfer amount must be positive")
129: 	}
130: 	if err := ApplyEntry(l, Entry{ID: id + ":out", Account: from, Amount: -amount, Category: "transfer"}); err != nil {
131: 		return err
132: 	}
133: 	if err := ApplyEntry(l, Entry{ID: id + ":in", Account: to, Amount: amount, Category: "transfer"}); err != nil {
134: 		return err
135: 	}
136: 	return nil
137: }
138: 
139: // Import applies every entry and stops at the first error, reporting how many
140: // were applied.
141: func Import(l *Ledger, entries []Entry) (int, error) {
142: 	for i, e := range entries {
143: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
144: 			return i, fmt.Errorf("ledger: import entry %d: %w", i, err)
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: 	return len(entries), nil
148: }

9: 
10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }

87: // Accounts lists the accounts that have at least one entry, sorted.
88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}

95: }

100: 	copy(out, l.entries)
101: 	return out
102: }

22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}

26: }

30: 	l := NewLedger()

32: 	lineNo := 0

8: )
9: 
10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }
86: 
87: // Accounts lists the accounts that have at least one entry, sorted.
88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}
93: 	sort.Strings(names)
94: 	return names
95: }
96: 
97: // Entries returns a copy of the entries in posting order.
98: func (l *Ledger) Entries() []Entry {
99: 	out := make([]Entry, len(l.entries))
100: 	copy(out, l.entries)
101: 	return out
102: }
103: 
104: // ByCategory groups entry amounts by category.
105: func (l *Ledger) ByCategory() map[string]int64 {
106: 	out := map[string]int64{}
107: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
108: 		out[e.Category] += e.Amount
109: 	}
110: 	return out
111: }

113: // Between returns the entries posted in [from, to).
114: func (l *Ledger) Between(from, to time.Time) []Entry {
115: 	var out []Entry
116: 	for _, e := range l.entries {

407: // SummarizeQuarter aggregates the entries posted in one calendar quarter.
408: func SummarizeQuarter(l *Ledger, year, quarter int) QuarterSummary {
409: 	from, to := quarterBounds(year, quarter)
410: 	summary := QuarterSummary{Year: year, Quarter: quarter, ByCat: map[string]int64{}}
411: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
412: 	for _, e := range l.Between(from, to) {
413: 		summary.Entries++
414: 		if e.Amount >= 0 {
415: 			summary.Income += e.Amount
416: 		} else {
417: 			summary.Expense -= e.Amount
418: 		}
419: 		summary.ByCat[e.Category] += e.Amount
420: 		seen[e.Account] = struct{}{}
421: 	}
422: 	for name := range seen {
423: 		summary.Accounts = append(summary.Accounts, name)
424: 	}
425: 	sort.Strings(summary.Accounts)
426: 	return summary
427: }

504: // validateSummary checks a summary before it is rendered.
505: func validateSummary(s QuarterSummary) error {
506: 	// Validation rules for a quarterly summary. Each rule is checked in
507: 	// order and the first failure wins; the messages are user-facing.
508: 	if s.Quarter < 1 || s.Quarter > 4 {
509: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: quarter %d is outside 1-4", s.Quarter)
510: 	}
511: 	if s.Year < 1970 {
512: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: year %d is before the epoch", s.Year)
513: 	}
514: 	if s.Income < 0 || s.Expense < 0 {
515: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: income and expense must be non-negative")
516: 	}
517: 	if len(s.ByCat) == 0 && s.Entries > 0 {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: %d entries but no categories", s.Entries)
519: 	}
520: 	return nil
521: }

407: // SummarizeQuarter aggregates the entries posted in one calendar quarter.
408: func SummarizeQuarter(l *Ledger, year, quarter int) QuarterSummary {
409: 	from, to := quarterBounds(year, quarter)
410: 	summary := QuarterSummary{Year: year, Quarter: quarter, ByCat: map[string]int64{}}
411: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
412: 	for _, e := range l.Between(from, to) {
413: 		summary.Entries++
414: 		if e.Amount >= 0 {
415: 			summary.Income += e.Amount
416: 		} else {
417: 			summary.Expense -= e.Amount
418: 		}
419: 		summary.ByCat[e.Category] += e.Amount
420: 		seen[e.Account] = struct{}{}
421: 	}
422: 	for name := range seen {
423: 		summary.Accounts = append(summary.Accounts, name)
424: 	}
425: 	sort.Strings(summary.Accounts)
426: 	return summary
427: }

504: // validateSummary checks a summary before it is rendered.
505: func validateSummary(s QuarterSummary) error {
506: 	// Validation rules for a quarterly summary. Each rule is checked in
507: 	// order and the first failure wins; the messages are user-facing.
508: 	if s.Quarter < 1 || s.Quarter > 4 {
509: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: quarter %d is outside 1-4", s.Quarter)
510: 	}
511: 	if s.Year < 1970 {
512: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: year %d is before the epoch", s.Year)
513: 	}
514: 	if s.Income < 0 || s.Expense < 0 {
515: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: income and expense must be non-negative")
516: 	}
517: 	if len(s.ByCat) == 0 && s.Entries > 0 {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: %d entries but no categories", s.Entries)
519: 	}
520: 	return nil
521: }

12: // Save writes the ledger as tab-separated lines: id, account, amount,
13: // currency, category, posted (RFC 3339), memo.
14: func Save(w io.Writer, l *Ledger) error {
15: 	bw := bufio.NewWriter(w)
16: 	for _, e := range l.Entries() {
17: 		line := strings.Join([]string{
18: 			e.ID, e.Account, strconv.FormatInt(e.Amount, 10), e.Currency, e.Category,
19: 			e.Posted.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), e.Memo,
20: 		}, "\t")
21: 		if _, err := bw.WriteString(line + "\n"); err != nil {
22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: 	return bw.Flush()
26: }
27: 
28: // Load reads lines written by Save and applies them to a new ledger.
29: func Load(r io.Reader) (*Ledger, error) {
30: 	l := NewLedger()
31: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)
32: 	lineNo := 0
33: 	for scanner.Scan() {
34: 		lineNo++
35: 		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), "\t")
36: 		if len(fields) != 7 {
37: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d has %d fields, want 7", lineNo, len(fields))
38: 		}
39: 		amount, err := strconv.ParseInt(fields[2], 10, 64)
40: 		if err != nil {
41: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d amount: %w", lineNo, err)
42: 		}
43: 		posted, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fields[5])
44: 		if err != nil {
45: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d posted: %w", lineNo, err)
46: 		}
47: 		e := Entry{ID: fields[0], Account: fields[1], Amount: amount, Currency: fields[3], Category: fields[4], Posted: posted, Memo: fields[6]}
48: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
49: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d: %w", lineNo, err)
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: 	return l, scanner.Err()
53: }

10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }

88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}
93: 	sort.Strings(names)
94: 	return names
95: }

98: func (l *Ledger) Entries() []Entry {

101: 	return out
102: }

106: 	out := map[string]int64{}

407: // SummarizeQuarter aggregates the entries posted in one calendar quarter.
408: func SummarizeQuarter(l *Ledger, year, quarter int) QuarterSummary {
409: 	from, to := quarterBounds(year, quarter)
410: 	summary := QuarterSummary{Year: year, Quarter: quarter, ByCat: map[string]int64{}}
411: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
412: 	for _, e := range l.Between(from, to) {
413: 		summary.Entries++
414: 		if e.Amount >= 0 {
415: 			summary.Income += e.Amount
416: 		} else {
417: 			summary.Expense -= e.Amount
418: 		}
419: 		summary.ByCat[e.Category] += e.Amount
420: 		seen[e.Account] = struct{}{}
421: 	}
422: 	for name := range seen {
423: 		summary.Accounts = append(summary.Accounts, name)
424: 	}
425: 	sort.Strings(summary.Accounts)
426: 	return summary
427: }

504: // validateSummary checks a summary before it is rendered.
505: func validateSummary(s QuarterSummary) error {
506: 	// Validation rules for a quarterly summary. Each rule is checked in
507: 	// order and the first failure wins; the messages are user-facing.
508: 	if s.Quarter < 1 || s.Quarter > 4 {
509: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: quarter %d is outside 1-4", s.Quarter)
510: 	}
511: 	if s.Year < 1970 {
512: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: year %d is before the epoch", s.Year)
513: 	}
514: 	if s.Income < 0 || s.Expense < 0 {
515: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: income and expense must be non-negative")
516: 	}
517: 	if len(s.ByCat) == 0 && s.Entries > 0 {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: %d entries but no categories", s.Entries)
519: 	}
520: 	return nil
521: }

1: package ledger
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"errors"
5: 	"fmt"
6: 	"sort"
7: 	"time"
8: )
9: 
10: // DefaultCurrency is the currency assumed for entries that do not name one.
11: const DefaultCurrency = "USD"
12: 
13: // MaxEntries bounds a ledger so an unbounded import cannot exhaust memory.
14: const MaxEntries = 10000
15: 
16: // Entry is one posted amount. Amounts are in minor units (cents).
17: type Entry struct {
18: 	ID       string
19: 	Account  string
20: 	Amount   int64
21: 	Currency string
22: 	Category string
23: 	Posted   time.Time
24: 	Memo     string
25: }
26: 
27: // Ledger is an append-only list of entries with a per-account balance cache.
28: type Ledger struct {
29: 	entries  []Entry
30: 	balances map[string]int64
31: 	seen     map[string]struct{}
32: }
33: 
34: // ErrDuplicate is returned when an entry ID was already applied.
35: var ErrDuplicate = errors.New("ledger: duplicate entry")
36: 
37: // ErrFull is returned when the ledger holds MaxEntries entries.
38: var ErrFull = errors.New("ledger: full")
39: 
40: // NewLedger returns an empty ledger.
41: func NewLedger() *Ledger {
42: 	return &Ledger{balances: map[string]int64{}, seen: map[string]struct{}{}}
43: }
44: 
45: // ApplyEntry validates and appends one entry, updating the account balance.
46: func ApplyEntry(l *Ledger, e Entry) error {
47: 	if e.ID == "" {
48: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an id")
49: 	}
50: 	if e.Account == "" {
51: 		return errors.New("ledger: entry needs an account")
52: 	}
53: 	if _, dup := l.seen[e.ID]; dup {
54: 		return ErrDuplicate
55: 	}
56: 	if len(l.entries) >= MaxEntries {
57: 		return ErrFull
58: 	}
59: 	if e.Currency == "" {
60: 		e.Currency = DefaultCurrency
61: 	}
62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {
63: 		e.Posted = time.Now().UTC()
64: 	}
65: 	l.entries = append(l.entries, e)
66: 	l.seen[e.ID] = struct{}{}
67: 	l.balances[e.Account] += e.Amount
68: 	return nil
69: }
70: 
71: // Balance returns the balance of one account, summed from the entries so the
72: // cache can be cross-checked.
73: func (l *Ledger) Balance(account string) int64 {
74: 	var total int64
75: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
76: 		if e.Account != account {
77: 			continue
78: 		}
79: 		total += e.Amount
80: 	}
81: 	if cached, ok := l.balances[account]; ok && cached != total {
82: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("ledger: balance cache drift for %s: %d != %d", account, cached, total))
83: 	}
84: 	return total
85: }
86: 
87: // Accounts lists the accounts that have at least one entry, sorted.
88: func (l *Ledger) Accounts() []string {
89: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(l.balances))
90: 	for name := range l.balances {
91: 		names = append(names, name)
92: 	}
93: 	sort.Strings(names)
94: 	return names
95: }
96: 
97: // Entries returns a copy of the entries in posting order.
98: func (l *Ledger) Entries() []Entry {
99: 	out := make([]Entry, len(l.entries))
100: 	copy(out, l.entries)
101: 	return out
102: }
103: 
104: // ByCategory groups entry amounts by category.
105: func (l *Ledger) ByCategory() map[string]int64 {
106: 	out := map[string]int64{}
107: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
108: 		out[e.Category] += e.Amount
109: 	}
110: 	return out
111: }
112: 
113: // Between returns the entries posted in [from, to).
114: func (l *Ledger) Between(from, to time.Time) []Entry {
115: 	var out []Entry
116: 	for _, e := range l.entries {
117: 		if !e.Posted.Before(from) && e.Posted.Before(to) {
118: 			out = append(out, e)
119: 		}
120: 	}
121: 	return out
122: }
123: 
124: // Transfer posts a matching pair of entries moving amount from one account to
125: // another. Both entries share the transfer id prefix.
126: func Transfer(l *Ledger, id, from, to string, amount int64) error {
127: 	if amount <= 0 {
128: 		return errors.New("ledger: transfer amount must be positive")
129: 	}
130: 	if err := ApplyEntry(l, Entry{ID: id + ":out", Account: from, Amount: -amount, Category: "transfer"}); err != nil {
131: 		return err
132: 	}
133: 	if err := ApplyEntry(l, Entry{ID: id + ":in", Account: to, Amount: amount, Category: "transfer"}); err != nil {
134: 		return err
135: 	}
136: 	return nil
137: }
138: 
139: // Import applies every entry and stops at the first error, reporting how many
140: // were applied.
141: func Import(l *Ledger, entries []Entry) (int, error) {
142: 	for i, e := range entries {
143: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
144: 			return i, fmt.Errorf("ledger: import entry %d: %w", i, err)
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: 	return len(entries), nil
148: }

1: package ledger
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"bufio"

10: )
11: 
12: // Save writes the ledger as tab-separated lines: id, account, amount,
13: // currency, category, posted (RFC 3339), memo.
14: func Save(w io.Writer, l *Ledger) error {
15: 	bw := bufio.NewWriter(w)
16: 	for _, e := range l.Entries() {
17: 		line := strings.Join([]string{
18: 			e.ID, e.Account, strconv.FormatInt(e.Amount, 10), e.Currency, e.Category,
19: 			e.Posted.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), e.Memo,
20: 		}, "\t")
21: 		if _, err := bw.WriteString(line + "\n"); err != nil {
22: 			return err
23: 		}
24: 	}
25: 	return bw.Flush()
26: }
27: 
28: // Load reads lines written by Save and applies them to a new ledger.
29: func Load(r io.Reader) (*Ledger, error) {
30: 	l := NewLedger()
31: 	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(r)
32: 	lineNo := 0
33: 	for scanner.Scan() {
34: 		lineNo++
35: 		fields := strings.Split(scanner.Text(), "\t")
36: 		if len(fields) != 7 {
37: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d has %d fields, want 7", lineNo, len(fields))
38: 		}
39: 		amount, err := strconv.ParseInt(fields[2], 10, 64)
40: 		if err != nil {
41: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d amount: %w", lineNo, err)
42: 		}
43: 		posted, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, fields[5])
44: 		if err != nil {
45: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d posted: %w", lineNo, err)
46: 		}
47: 		e := Entry{ID: fields[0], Account: fields[1], Amount: amount, Currency: fields[3], Category: fields[4], Posted: posted, Memo: fields[6]}
48: 		if err := ApplyEntry(l, e); err != nil {
49: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("store: line %d: %w", lineNo, err)
50: 		}
51: 	}
52: 	return l, scanner.Err()
53: }

407: // SummarizeQuarter aggregates the entries posted in one calendar quarter.
408: func SummarizeQuarter(l *Ledger, year, quarter int) QuarterSummary {
409: 	from, to := quarterBounds(year, quarter)
410: 	summary := QuarterSummary{Year: year, Quarter: quarter, ByCat: map[string]int64{}}
411: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
412: 	for _, e := range l.Between(from, to) {
413: 		summary.Entries++
414: 		if e.Amount >= 0 {
415: 			summary.Income += e.Amount
416: 		} else {
417: 			summary.Expense -= e.Amount
418: 		}
419: 		summary.ByCat[e.Category] += e.Amount
420: 		seen[e.Account] = struct{}{}
421: 	}
422: 	for name := range seen {
423: 		summary.Accounts = append(summary.Accounts, name)
424: 	}
425: 	sort.Strings(summary.Accounts)
426: 	return summary
427: }

504: // validateSummary checks a summary before it is rendered.
505: func validateSummary(s QuarterSummary) error {
506: 	// Validation rules for a quarterly summary. Each rule is checked in
507: 	// order and the first failure wins; the messages are user-facing.
508: 	if s.Quarter < 1 || s.Quarter > 4 {
509: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: quarter %d is outside 1-4", s.Quarter)
510: 	}
511: 	if s.Year < 1970 {
512: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: year %d is before the epoch", s.Year)
513: 	}
514: 	if s.Income < 0 || s.Expense < 0 {
515: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: income and expense must be non-negative")
516: 	}
517: 	if len(s.ByCat) == 0 && s.Entries > 0 {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: %d entries but no categories", s.Entries)
519: 	}
520: 	return nil
521: }

62: 	if e.Posted.IsZero() {

407: // SummarizeQuarter aggregates the entries posted in one calendar quarter.
408: func SummarizeQuarter(l *Ledger, year, quarter int) QuarterSummary {
409: 	from, to := quarterBounds(year, quarter)
410: 	summary := QuarterSummary{Year: year, Quarter: quarter, ByCat: map[string]int64{}}
411: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
412: 	for _, e := range l.Between(from, to) {
413: 		summary.Entries++
414: 		if e.Amount >= 0 {
415: 			summary.Income += e.Amount
416: 		} else {
417: 			summary.Expense -= e.Amount
418: 		}
419: 		summary.ByCat[e.Category] += e.Amount
420: 		seen[e.Account] = struct{}{}
421: 	}
422: 	for name := range seen {
423: 		summary.Accounts = append(summary.Accounts, name)
424: 	}
425: 	sort.Strings(summary.Accounts)
426: 	return summary
427: }

504: // validateSummary checks a summary before it is rendered.
505: func validateSummary(s QuarterSummary) error {
506: 	// Validation rules for a quarterly summary. Each rule is checked in
507: 	// order and the first failure wins; the messages are user-facing.
508: 	if s.Quarter < 1 || s.Quarter > 4 {
509: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: quarter %d is outside 1-4", s.Quarter)
510: 	}
511: 	if s.Year < 1970 {
512: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: year %d is before the epoch", s.Year)
513: 	}
514: 	if s.Income < 0 || s.Expense < 0 {
515: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: income and expense must be non-negative")
516: 	}
517: 	if len(s.ByCat) == 0 && s.Entries > 0 {
518: 		return fmt.Errorf("report: %d entries but no categories", s.Entries)
519: 	}
520: 	return nil
521: }
